Record Class Range<C extends Comparable<? super C>>

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
be.imgn.gaia.core.collect.Range<C>
Type Parameters:
C - the type of the values
Record Components:
lower - the lower bound
upper - the upper bound
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public record Range<C extends Comparable<? super C>>(Range.Bound<C extends Comparable<? super C>> lower, Range.Bound<C extends Comparable<? super C>> upper) extends Record implements Serializable
An interval of comparable values: all the values between a lower and an upper bound. Each bound is either closed, and includes its endpoint, open, and excludes it, or absent, and lets the range extend forever on that side. 
Range<Integer> digits = Range.closedOpen(0, 10);
digits.contains(9);  // true
digits.contains(10); // false
digits.toString();   // [0, 10)

The values are compared with their compareTo method, which must be consistent: a range contains a value if it compares between the endpoints, whether it equals them or not.

A range may be empty when its endpoints are equal and one bound is open, as in [3, 3). Its lower bound cannot be above its upper bound, and both bounds cannot be open with equal endpoints, as in (3, 3).

Ranges are unmodifiable, and serializable if their endpoints are. Two ranges are equal if their bounds are, so two empty ranges may differ: [3, 3) does not equal (3, 3].

Since:
0.1.2
